build_EfficientGraphAttentionBlock: build an EfficientGraphAttentionBlock with global, molecular graph, GNN, and regularization configs for molecular graph neural networks
run_EfficientGraphAttentionBlock_forward: run the EfficientGraphAttentionBlock forward pass with graph attention data, node features, and edge features tensors
build_EfficientGraphAttention: build an EfficientGraphAttention module with multi-head self-attention, frequency embeddings, and optional graph attention aggregation
run_multi_head_self_attention: run multi-head self-attention on input tensors with optional attention masks and frequency vector embeddings
build_FeedForwardNetwork: build a FeedForwardNetwork with configurable node and edge MLP layers for graph neural network blocks
